what: XPO is a freight transportation company focused on less-than-truckload shipping in North America, where shipments from many customers share a trailer, plus a European transport business.
customers: Manufacturers, retailers and distributors shipping pallets rather than full truckloads, about 55,000 customers in total.
money: less-than-truckload freight through its own terminal network
truckload, LTL and logistics across Europe
moat: A terminal network and door capacity in North America that would take years and great expense to replicate, bought cheaply when a competitor failed.
risks: Freight volumes have been weak for three years
Revenue grew only about 1% last year
Debt of about $3.8 billion against almost no cash
opportunities: Analysts see about 23% upside from current levels
Service improvements have let it raise prices per shipment faster than peers
A freight recovery would flow through to profits quickly given spare terminal capacity
watch: LTL tonnage, yield per hundredweight, and the operating ratio.
